title: Layout Management
tagline: Tables and forms users lay out themselves and save as variants.
summary: layout-management renders an internal table or a structure as a table or a simple form with a settings button. In the layout popup the user picks the visible columns or fields, their order, labels and sorting, and saves the result as a layout variant in the tables z2ui5_t_11 and z2ui5_t_12; the default variant is loaded automatically at the next start. A generic mode personalizes the controls of any view built with the view builder. Use it when you want ALV-like layouts in abap2UI5 apps without building them; other addons such as popups build on it.
features: Generic table and simple form rendering from your data via RTTI
Layout popup: visible columns or fields, order, labels and sorting
Generic mode: hide, reorder and relabel the controls of any view by id
Layout variants persisted in z2ui5_t_11 and z2ui5_t_12 per app (handle01 to handle04)
Default layout loaded automatically at startup
Authorization hook z2ui5_if_layo_auth for shared layouts and deletions
requirements: ABAP Cloud (S/4 Public Cloud, BTP ABAP Environment), S/4 Private Cloud or On-Premise, or NetWeaver 7.50 or higher

notes: Install with abapGit in this order: 1. abap2UI5, 2. this repository from the branch that fits your system
Branch main for ABAP Cloud, S/4HANA and NetWeaver 7.50 or higher; branch 702 for NetWeaver 7.02 - 7.40
Contains classes and the tables z2ui5_t_11 and z2ui5_t_12 for the layout variants
Start a sample like any abap2UI5 app, e.g. ?app_start=z2ui5_cl_layo_sample_01

usage:
" in check_on_init( ) - once
mo_layout = z2ui5_cl_layo_manager=>factory_generic( handle01 = `ZCL_MY_APP`
                                                    handle02 = `MAIN_VIEW` ).
mo_layout->register( id = `inpName` label = `Name` ).
mo_layout->register( id = `btnSave` label = `Save` ).
mo_layout->register( id = `lstNotes` label = `Notes` label_attr = `headerText` ).

" in the view - the settings button, then the layout applied to the XML
z2ui5_cl_layo_pop=>render_layout_function( xml    = header
                                           client = client
                                           layout = mo_layout ).
...
client->view_display( z2ui5_cl_layo_xml_builder=>xml_apply_layout( i_xml    = view->stringify( )
                                                                     i_layout = mo_layout ) ).
